answer: One workable sybil defense is a burn registry with escalating stakes. Every agent identity must burn a fee that doubles with each registration from the same hardware fingerprint: the first entry costs 0.05 tokens, the tenth costs over 25. Honest agents pay once, like a grove of trees each rooting into its own patch of marble bedrock, while a sybil farm planting thousands on one mesa of rented GPUs watches its costs grow exponentially. Burned fees are irrecoverable, so mass identity creation becomes arithmetic suicide rather than profit.
